name: QiYi Sandwich Void Cube 3x3
description: The QiYi Sandwich Void Cube 3x3 is a playful and eye-catching twist on the classic 3x3 puzzle. It features a unique “sandwich” color scheme with three distinct horizontal layers and a hollow center, creating a fun visual effect and an interesting solving experience. Despite lacking a core, the cube maintains smooth, stable turning thanks to its smart internal mechanism.
